rationale: The heartbeat account's realism claim, that the term inversion occurs under genuine file-system latency rather than an injected sleep, rests on one execution: receipt f87365ea88ba4a48a610ba8f380419b0 wrote and fsynced every current-term update and recorded 89 inversions in 200 attempts with a mean write near 2 ms. A single run cannot separate a property of this filesystem from an accident of one run's scheduling. Repeating the same fixed experiment from its retained inputs runs the identical file-write-plus-fsync harness, so a second count either confirms the exposure or shows it varies.
